# Lematter

> Lematter is an open source AI platform for life science research. It gives grounded, citation-backed answers instead of generic AI responses, and is built for the trust, privacy, and compliance needs of researchers, labs, and institutions.

Lematter is designed specifically for research and lab use. Every answer is grounded in real sources with verifiable citations. The platform is open source and can be self-hosted so data stays within your own infrastructure.

## Key features

- Knowledge Graph: understands how scientific concepts relate to one another and connects ideas across research.
- Semantic Search: finds relevant research based on meaning, not exact wording.
- Data Sovereignty: keeps your data within your own environment; nothing sensitive has to leave your control.
- Open Source: everything about how the platform works is open and inspectable.
- Compliance Controls: built to meet standards required in regulated research settings.
- Lab Integration: fits into the tools and workflows teams already use.

## Who it is for

- Researchers, labs, biotech teams, and institutions that need trustworthy AI support for their work.

## Pricing

- The open source core is free to use.
